text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the present, you two. A bath 
gift set is so lovely♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I remembered how much you loved 
bath time, Crown~ I'm so glad you like it♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It smells super nice, so I always use it 
whenever I take a bath with Big Sis ♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It has a slightly sweet scent, so I think 
it'd be great for when you want to relax.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Cheval told me once 
that you two often take baths together in 
the dorms!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As you know, Vivlos is quite the 
spoiled sweetheart.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because when I'm with you, Big Sis, we can 
chat a whole bunch and it's so much fuuun♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ... Let's chat together in the bath――

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I remember taking baths with Dia back in 
the day, chatting away until we got dizzy 
from the heat. We're in different dorms 
now, so we don't get the chance anymore, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should invite her out sometime. 
Just the two of us, taking it easy and 
having fun like old times.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! That's super great♡ I'm sure Dia will 
love it too!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, you two are 
practically like sisters, aren't you? I 
hope you have a wonderful time together.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm sure it's going to be a wonderful 
time. Fufu♪
